title: Shadow Dance — Graphic Novel Cut
story: Alex walks a cyberpunk night with her Companion Android. Memory and neon dust replace dance and combat; the story is told only in images — no words, no SFX.
style_lock: Mature high-end graphic novel: rich ink washes, detailed hatch shading, subtle charcoal textures, expressive atmospheric lighting, thick clean ink boundary profiles, micro-detailed clothing and cyberpunk architecture. Elegant elongated human proportions (lengthened legs). Absolutely no comic text, speech bubbles, sound-effect letters, or onomatopoeia.

characters.alex: Female protagonist Alex — long wavy golden-orange hair, fair skin, sharp eyes, edgy studded black motorcycle leather jacket, elongated elegant proportions with lengthened legs
characters.companion_android: Very tall strikingly handsome humanoid android — high-gloss polished chrome and brushed obsidian-gold metallic finish, cinematic low-angle framing, fluid chrome reflections
